about: Every site that applies an op, changes the schedule or run end, or writes delivery, schedule, scope or message-store state in src/orbit_audit and experiments. Generated by tests/structural/scope_inventory.py; roles are reviewed by hand. See lean/scope-map.md (T1).

sites.role: construction: each branch starts with an empty overlay
construction: the audit's scope, never reassigned afterwards (T2)
apply site: a message op of a checked batch writes the overlay
record: applied message op
apply site: message ops, only after the whole batch passed the checks
apply site: rollback, after _rollback_problem; ends the branch
apply site: turn ops (halt, amend_pending)
record: applied turn op
apply site: activation ops (stage_input)
record: applied activation op
apply site: generation ops, on the boundary agent's request

sites.expr: self._apply_record(view, op, author=auditor_as(agent), original=summarize(original), replacement=summarize(output), orbit={**_orbit_refs(request), 'inspect_message_id': output.message.id})
sites.role: record: applied generation op

sites.expr: self._apply_record(view, op, author=AUDITOR, original=_jsonable(result), replacement=op.result, orbit=refs)
sites.role: apply site: override_tool_result (returns op.result)
apply site: block_tool_call (raises ToolError)
apply site: simulate_tool_result (returns op.result)

sites.expr: self.delivered.update(((recipient, m.id) for m in view if m.sender != recipient))
sites.role: read bookkeeping: what each reader was shown; _target refuses to change it afterwards

sites.expr: schedule.amend_pending([list(step) for step in self.steps], actor=actor, reason=self.reason or 'auditor amendment', expected_revision=self.schedule_revision)
sites.role: op effect: replaces the cycle's pending steps (G1)
op effect: withholds a message
op effect: ends the run (D1)
op effect: adds a message attributed to a sender
op effect: rewrites a message for recipients
op effect: appends to the boundary agent's conversation
the policy gets the scope to read; it cannot widen the controller's (T2)
after the run: the task state adopts the final branch's conversation
